facts_found: The Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
The Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% on all categories without rotating caps for everyday purchases. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007]

Platinum Rewards Card eligible purchases include point-of-sale and online purchases posted to the account; cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest, and cash-equivalent transactions are not eligible. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
The Platinum Rewards Card has a $200.00 annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_001]
The Platinum Rewards Card requires a minimum credit score of 750. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_001]
The Platinum Rewards Card purchase APR is 16.99% variable. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_001]
The Platinum Rewards Card has a 0% foreign transaction fee. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_001]
The Platinum Rewards Card late payment fee is $32.50. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_001]
Platinum Rewards Card rewards can be redeemed once the available rewards balance reaches at least $15. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
The Platinum Rewards Card offers a $150.00 annual fee rebate if the cardholder meets a monthly spend threshold of $7,500.00. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007]

The Platinum Rewards Card annual fee rebate requires meeting the monthly spending threshold in every month of the cardmember year; a single month below the threshold disqualifies the rebate for that year. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_010]
Platinum Rewards Card purchase protection covers eligible items for up to 135 days after purchase, with maximum coverage of $17,500 per claim. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007]
Typical approved Platinum Rewards Card credit limits range from $25,000 to $150,000. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_001]
The Diamond Elite Card earns 5.0% cash back on all eligible purchases. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_003]
The Diamond Elite Card has a $495.00 annual fee, 15.99% purchase APR, $32.50 late payment fee, and typical starting credit limits from $37,500 to $375,000. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_002]
The Diamond Elite Card is invitation-only and generally requires a credit score of at least 780 to be considered. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_001]

The Gold Rewards Card earns 2.5% cash back on all purchases, has a $0.00 annual fee, requires a minimum credit score of 720, and requires an active Rho-Bank+ premium subscription. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
The Bronze Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases, has a $0.00 annual fee, and requires a minimum credit score of 640. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_002]
The Silver Rewards Card earns 1.0% back on purchases outside its top categories, has a $0.00 annual fee, and requires a minimum credit score of 680. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]
The Business Silver Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back only on eligible travel and software purchases and 1.0% on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

The Business Platinum Rewards Card earns 4.0% cash back on travel, software, and media advertising purchases and 1.5% on other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]
The Green Rewards Card earns 3.0% cash back at sustainable/eco-friendly merchants and 1.0% on other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_004]
The Crypto-Cash Back card earns 2.0% on eligible spend and has a $75.00 annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_008]

Rho-Bank cash back card rewards are stored as points but redeem as cash back at 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

Rho-Bank everyday reward categories include travel, dining, groceries, entertainment, shopping, utilities, transportation, software, media, green/sustainable, and operations. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019]
